title: Vowels
intro: Examples use ၵ (ka) to show vowels in syllables. Vowel spelling can change before a final consonant. Select ႆ or ႂ် to see their vowel examples.

items.label: ai
items.note: Vowel sign in ai, aai and awi spellings. Select to see examples.

detail.title: Vowel ႆ
detail.intro: ႆ is a vowel sign called Shan final y. It forms ai and combines with other vowel signs to form aai and awi. Read it together with the initial letter and any other vowel sign.

items.label: Aaai
items.note: ဢ + ၢ ႆ · long aai vowel ending

items.label: aue
items.note: Vowel combination ႂ်. Select to see a syllable example.

detail.title: Vowel ႂ်
detail.intro: Read ႂ် together with the initial consonant as a vowel ending. Compare this combination with the medial ႂ used at the start of a syllable.

items.label: Aue
items.note: ဢ + ႂ် - vowel spelling practice without a tone mark.
